first_arrival_method: Average the sum of predictable native draw hazards while the seat has not yet seen Soup, including its first-hit draw. The stopped counting-process compensator estimates first-arrival probability under the actual policy. Bootstrap 10000 complete lobby routes, seed 51052; this is an estimate, not a universal cap or an exact ex-ante enumeration.
method: Each logged shop draw hazard is q(T1 among nonempty tier weights) * actual Soup copies left / actual T1 copies left, immediately before the unchanged native draw. Pool subclass delegates to the original draw and uses no extra random draws. Captured R1-R6 active stats and ordered card IDs must equal the original route for every seat.
qualification: Seen/bought/fielded are exact observations for these seeds. Products of realized-pool hazards along the observed route are descriptive path references, not ex-ante counterfactual policy probabilities: earlier hits change buys, freezes, climbs and the shared pool. Missing Soup opportunities cannot be repaired solely by choosing a different purchase on this fixed trace. This does not prove a universal mathematical impossibility or that another route cannot reach the bar.
